entities.summary: Michael James Cuccione was a Canadian actor, singer, dancer, author, and cancer research activist. He was best known for his role as "Jason 'Q.T.' McKnight" in the fictional boy band 2gether, part of a self-titled MTV movie and spin-off television series.
